consensus: Templates must keep capability, consent, and approval separate.
Dirty-worktree state must be recorded as structured data.
Cleanup manifests are candidate lists, not action authority.
Connector writes require explicit approval packets.
Advisory receipts cannot replace local Git receipts.
All GMUT gates remain open and outside THOS validation.
